en.Временные файлы, отчёты и кэши Windows: Temporary files, reports and caches of Windows
en.Только кэш — пароли, cookies, история и: Cache only — passwords, cookies, history and tabs are not touched
en.Кэши шейдеров и лаунчеров — по желанию,: Shader and launcher caches — optional; stutter is possible after deleting them
en.Кэши мессенджеров, Office и инструментов: Caches of messengers, Office and developer tools
en.Корзина, журналы, дампы сбоев и обслужив: Recycle Bin, logs, crash dumps and Windows servicing — deliberately, one at a time
en.Отложено: {0}. Перезагрузите ПК или повт: Postponed: {0}. Restart the PC or try again later.
en.Отложено: идёт установка программы (Wind: Postponed: a program is being installed (Windows Installer). Try again when it finishes.
en.Центр обновления сейчас активен — повтор: Windows Update is active right now — try again later. MONOLITH does not stop its services.
en.Папка TEMP вашей учётной записи: распако: The TEMP folder of your account: unpacked installers, temporary copies of documents, leftovers of program updates. Only files older than 24 hours are deleted.
en.Незавершённая установка не сможет продол: An unfinished installation will not be able to resume where it stopped. Files in use and files a pending installation is waiting for are skipped.
en.Общая временная папка Windows (Windows\\: The shared Windows temporary folder (Windows\Temp): leftovers of installers, drivers and system services older than 24 hours.
en.Без побочных эффектов. Пункт пропускаетс: No side effects. The item is skipped while Windows is installing updates or waiting for a restart.
en.Временные файлы служб, работающих от име: Temporary files of services that run as SYSTEM (Windows 11 and updated Windows 10). Files older than 7 days are deleted.
en.Без побочных эффектов. Защищённые файлы,: No side effects. Protected files you have no access to are skipped — MONOLITH does not change their permissions.
en.Отчёты о сбоях программ, которые Windows: Program crash reports that Windows collected for your account. Reports older than 7 days are deleted.
en.В «Мониторе стабильности системы» пропад: The technical details of old crashes will disappear from Reliability Monitor.
en.Отправленные и неотправленные отчёты о с: Sent and unsent crash reports of the system and services older than 7 days.
en.Отправленные отчёты больше не нужны, а н: Sent reports are no longer needed, and Windows deletes unsent ones by itself in time.
en.Кэш встроенного веб-движка Windows: спра: Cache of the built-in Windows web engine: help, widgets, Internet Explorer mode in Edge and old programs. Files older than 7 days are deleted.
en.Такие страницы один раз загрузятся занов: Such pages will load again once. Opened Outlook attachments (Content.Outlook) are not touched.
en.Копии скачанных обновлений Windows и при: Copies of downloaded Windows updates and Store apps that the Delivery Optimization service keeps to share with other PCs. Deleted with the standard Delete-DeliveryOptimizationCache command.
en.Другие компьютеры в сети не смогут получ: Other computers on the network will not be able to get these files from your PC. Pinned files are kept.
en.Пакеты, которые скачал Центр обновления: Packages downloaded by Windows Update. Files older than 10 days are deleted, and only while the update service is stopped.
en.Если обновление ещё не установлено, Wind: If an update is not installed yet, Windows will download it again. MONOLITH does not stop the update services.
en.Кэш страниц, скриптов и графики во всех: Cache of pages, scripts and graphics in all browser profiles. Passwords, cookies, history, tabs, bookmarks and extensions are not touched.
en.Сайты один раз загрузятся чуть медленнее: Sites will load a little slower once. {0} must be closed, including its background mode — otherwise the item is skipped.
en.Кэш страниц (cache2), кэш запуска и мини: Page cache (cache2), startup cache and thumbnails in all Firefox profiles. Passwords, cookies, history and sessions are not touched.
en.Сайты один раз загрузятся чуть медленнее: Sites will load a little slower once. Firefox must be closed — otherwise the item is skipped.
en.Офлайн-данные сайтов и отчёты о сбоях бр: Offline site data and browser crash reports
en.Кэш Service Worker (CacheStorage, Script: Service Worker cache (CacheStorage, ScriptCache) — offline copies of sites and web apps — and crash reports of Chromium-based browsers.
en.Установленные веб-приложения и сайты, ра: Installed web apps and sites that work offline will load again and may ask you to sign in once more.
en.Игры заново скомпилируют шейдеры: при пе: Games will recompile their shaders: freezes and stutter are possible on the first launch and in the first hours (especially DX12 and Unreal Engine). Worth doing only after a driver update or when you see graphical artifacts.
en.Скомпилированные шейдеры игр и программ: Compiled shaders of games and programs that use DirectX (D3DSCache). The driver limits the size of this cache itself — it is not junk.
en.Кэши шейдеров DirectX, OpenGL и CUDA дра: DirectX, OpenGL and CUDA shader caches of the NVIDIA driver (DXCache, GLCache, ComputeCache).
en.Игры заново скомпилируют шейдеры: при пе: Games will recompile their shaders: freezes and stutter are possible on the first launch and in the first hours (especially DX12 and Unreal Engine). Worth doing only after a driver update or when you see graphical artifacts. You can limit the cache size in the NVIDIA Control Panel or the NVIDIA App.
en.Кэши шейдеров DirectX, OpenGL и Vulkan д: DirectX, OpenGL and Vulkan shader caches of the AMD driver (DxCache, DxcCache, GLCache, VkCache).
en.Игры заново скомпилируют шейдеры: при пе: Games will recompile their shaders: freezes and stutter are possible on the first launch and in the first hours (especially DX12 and Unreal Engine). Worth doing only after a driver update or when you see graphical artifacts. The preferred way is AMD Adrenalin → Settings → Graphics → “Reset Shader Cache”.
en.Кэш магазина, сообщества и оверлея Steam: Cache of the Steam store, community and overlay — the same as “Delete Web Browser Data” in the Steam settings.
en.Страницы магазина загрузятся заново; в м: Store pages will load again; you may need to sign in once more in the store and the overlay. Steam must be closed.
en.Steam: HTTP-кэш, журналы и дампы: Steam: HTTP cache, logs and dumps
en.Кэш загрузок клиента (appcache\\httpcach: The client download cache (appcache\httpcache), Steam logs and its crash dumps older than 30 days. Library covers (librarycache) are not touched.
en.Steam один раз заново загрузит служебные: Steam will download its service data again once. Steam must be closed.
en.Папки shadercache игр, которых больше не: Shadercache folders of games that are no longer in your Steam library (no appmanifest file). The cache of installed games is not touched.
en.Побочных эффектов нет: если игру установ: No side effects: if you install the game again, Steam will download or rebuild its shaders. Steam must be closed.
en.Кэш картинок, скриптов и графики Discord: Cache of images, scripts and graphics of Discord (stable, PTB and Canary). Sign-in data (Local Storage) and settings are not touched.
en.Аватары и вложения загрузятся заново. Di: Avatars and attachments will load again. Discord must be closed, including the notification area — otherwise the item is skipped.
en.Кэш веб-интерфейса нового и классическог: Web interface cache of new and classic Teams. Only cache folders are deleted — settings and sign-in are kept.
en.Первый запуск Teams после очистки будет: The first Teams launch after cleaning will be slower. Teams must be closed.
en.Кэш веб-надстроек Office (Wef). Помогает: Cache of Office web add-ins (Wef). Helps when an add-in does not load or is outdated. The document cache (OfficeFileCache) is not touched.
en.Надстройки загрузятся заново при следующ: Add-ins will load again the next time you open Word, Excel or Outlook. Office apps must be closed.
en.Кэш загрузок пакетов NuGet (v3-cache) и: Cache of NuGet package downloads (v3-cache) and its temporary files. Cleaned with the standard dotnet nuget locals command.
en.Следующая сборка заново скачает метаданн: The next build will download package metadata again. The global packages folder (.nuget\packages) is not touched. The item is skipped during a build.
en.Кэш пакетов npm (_cacache). Команда npm: The npm package cache (_cacache). The npm cache verify command removes corrupted and unneeded data; the working cache stays.
en.Без побочных эффектов: что удалить, реша: No side effects: npm itself decides what to delete. The item is skipped while Node.js is running.
en.Кэш скачанных пакетов Yarn. Очищается ко: Cache of downloaded Yarn packages. Cleaned with the yarn cache clean command.
en.Следующая установка зависимостей скачает: The next dependency install will download the packages again. The item is skipped while Node.js is running.
en.Кэш скачанных пакетов Python. Очищается: Cache of downloaded Python packages. Cleaned with the pip cache purge command.
en.Повторная установка пакетов скачает их з: Installing packages again will download them again.
en.Файлы, которые вы удалили в корзину, на: Files you deleted to the Recycle Bin, on all drives.
en.После очистки вернуть эти файлы будет не: After cleaning these files cannot be restored. Before deleting, MONOLITH shows the number of items and their size.
en.Старые архивы журналов обслуживания Wind: Old archives of Windows servicing logs (CbsPersist_*) and the DISM log if it is larger than 50 MB. The current CBS.log is not touched.
en.Пропадёт история проверок SFC и DISM ста: The history of SFC and DISM scans older than 30 days will be lost.
en.Журналы сетевой настройки (NetSetup), ус: Network setup logs (NetSetup), update installation logs (MoSetup, WindowsUpdate) and Windows Update recovery service logs older than 30 days. MeasuredBoot and WinREAgent are not touched.
en.Сложнее будет разобраться в давней ошибк: It will be harder to investigate an old update installation error.
en.Старые ротированные архивы журнала устан: Old rotated archives of the device installation log (setupapi.*.YYYYMMDD_HHMMSS.log). Current logs are kept.
en.Пропадёт история установки драйверов ста: The history of driver installations older than 30 days will be lost.
en.Файл, который Windows записывает при син: The file Windows writes on a blue screen (BSOD). It can take several gigabytes and contains data from RAM. Deleted only if it is older than 14 days.
en.Причину того синего экрана больше нельзя: The cause of that blue screen can no longer be analyzed.
en.Небольшие дампы ошибок BSOD старше 30 дн: Small BSOD crash dumps older than 30 days. The five newest are always kept.
en.Пропадут доказательства старых сбоев — е: Evidence of old crashes will be lost — if you are troubleshooting blue screens, do not delete.
en.Дампы зависаний драйверов старше 30 дней: Driver hang dumps older than 30 days: WATCHDOG — video driver resets (TDR), USBHUB3, NDIS. They often take gigabytes.
en.Это главное доказательство проблем видео: This is the main evidence of graphics card problems, including driver crashes on RTX 50. If you are troubleshooting GPU failures, do not delete.
en.Дампы памяти упавших программ старше 30: Memory dumps of crashed programs older than 30 days, saved by the Windows Error Reporting service.
en.Разработчики программ не смогут разобрат: Program developers will not be able to analyze old crashes from these files.
en.Штатная очистка DISM: сначала /AnalyzeCo: Standard DISM cleanup: /AnalyzeComponentStore first checks whether it is needed, then /StartComponentCleanup removes component versions replaced by updates. The /ResetBase mode is not used.
en.Безопасно, но необратимо: старые версии: Safe but irreversible: old versions are deleted at once, without the 30-day wait. Takes from a few minutes to an hour and loads the disk heavily — do not run it during a game.
